policies.title: Turkish ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry table expressly grants ordinary Turkish passport holders short visitor visa exemptions for Botswana, Jordan, North Macedonia, Trinidad and Tobago, and Vanuatu.
conditions: Botswana permits up to 90 days within 365 days; Jordan up to 90 days within 180 days; North Macedonia up to 90 days; Trinidad and Tobago and Vanuatu up to 30 days.
Work, residence, special documents, diplomatic or service passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.
